title: ACDP Key Attestation (acdp-key-attestation/1)
description: (0.5.0) The metadata of an 'acdp:key-attestation' body (RFC-ACDP-0021 §5.3): a registry's signed statement that, during [not_before, not_after), an ephemeral public key speaks for the controller DID because a workload identity that the controller's DID document authorizes presented a valid token for it. Closed at every level. Runtime checks not expressible here: key_fingerprint is the RFC-ACDP-0010 §6 fingerprint of public_key_jwk; key_id equals controller + '#acdp-kl-' + the fingerprint's hex; not_before < not_after and the window is at most 3600 seconds (RFC-ACDP-0021 §5.2).

controller.description: The did:web DID the attested key signs for. Producer bodies signed with the key carry it as agent_id (RFC-ACDP-0021 §6.2).

org_wide.description: Copied from the controller's DID-document entry at attestation time. true lets bodies signed with this key supersede any of the controller's lineages (RFC-ACDP-0021 §7).

key_id.description: The DID URL producers put in signature.key_id (RFC-ACDP-0021 §6.1).

algorithm.description: The signature algorithm of the attested key (registries/signature-algorithms.md).

public_key_jwk.description: The attested public key as a JWK (RFC 7517), in the canonical member set of RFC 7638 for its key type.

key_fingerprint.description: RFC-ACDP-0010 §6 fingerprint of the attested key. Receipts and log leaves of bodies signed with it carry the same value.

token_hash.description: sha256: + lowercase hex SHA-256 of the ASCII bytes of the presented token. For audit and single-use enforcement; the token itself is never published (RFC-ACDP-0021 §5.2).

identity.description: A workload identity, in the shape of the RFC-AITP-0002 identity hint: type, issuer (oidc only) and subject, with no proof.
